pet_notes: Nicole Demara as a compact polished 2D anime chibi, about three heads tall. Preserve her voluminous pink twin ponytails with black bow-like hair accessories, lime-green eyes, heart earrings, black-and-white asymmetrical crop top, black shorts with straps and white ruffle trim, mismatched black legwear, laced combat boots, lime-green Bangboo waist pouch, and a simplified compact black weapon case kept close to her body. Confident playful smirk; clean cel-shaded linework. No detached bullets, smoke, text, scenery, floor shadow, or loose effects.
